2608.31111.title: Aspire: Can Models Self-Evolve from Vague Goals?
2608.31111.paper_summary: Many important forms of human learning begin with a vague goal, such as "become a better physicist" or "improve at research." Learners must interpret the goal, identify capability gaps, decide how to learn, and determine whether they have actually improved. In contrast, existing work on LLM self-evolution typically begins with tasks and evaluation metrics specified by humans, reducing self-evolution to optimizing an explicit objective rather than deciding what and how to learn. We introduce ASPIRE, a benchmark for vague-goal-driven self-evolution. ASPIRE provides only a natural-language capability goal while downstream evaluation tasks remain hidden. The agent must operationalize the goal by choosing data and update methods, constructing training and validation signals, and deciding when to evaluate. ASPIRE supports both model-weight and agent-harness evolution in a unified interactive environment and evaluates the resulting systems on a hidden, expert-authored set of 520 items spanning six goals. Our experiments show that vague goals redirect search effort toward goal interpretation. Current agents routinely complete training and harness-editing loops, but weight-level gains remain sparse and unstable, and the strongest evolved harness remains below the engineered Qwen-Agent reference. Agents often train on mismatched data and trust narrow self-evaluations, so local gains fail to transfer to hidden evaluation and continued search and training can erase earlier improvements.
2608.31111.paper_summary_zh: 許多人類學習的重要形式始於模糊的目標，例如「成為更好的物理學家」或「提高研究能力」。學習者必須詮釋這個目標，識別能力差距，決定如何學習，以及確定自己是否真的有所改善。相比之下，現有的 LLM 自我進化工作通常以人類指定的任務和評估指標為起點，將自我進化簡化為優化明確的目標，而不是決定學習什麼和如何學習。我們介紹 ASPIRE，一個基於模糊目標驅動的自我進化基準。ASPIRE 只提供一個自然語言能力目標，而下游評估任務則保持隱藏。代理必須通過選擇數據和更新方法來具體化目標，構建訓練和驗證信號，並決定何時進行評估。ASPIRE 在統一的交互環境中支持模型權重和代理工具的進化，並在一組隱藏的、專家撰寫的520個項目上評估結果系統，這些項目涵蓋六個目標。我們的實驗表明，模糊目標將搜索努力重新引導至目標詮釋。當前的代理通常完成訓練和工具編輯循環，但權重層面的增益仍然稀疏且不穩定，而最強的進化工具仍低於工程化的 Qwen-Agent 參考。代理經常在不匹配的數據上進行訓練並信任狹隘的自我評估，因此局部增益無法轉移到隱藏評估上，持續的搜索和訓練可能會抹去早期的改進。
